skills.name: Rise to the Top
skills.description: Fixes uniform collar and gazes ahead.  Good effects on allies.  *Move Speed +130% (10 sec) *Skill Hit Rate +30% (10 sec) *Resets the Skill cooldown of some allies.

skills.name: Beast Out
skills.description: Jumps and does a spinning kick, delivering consecutive strikes.  *Continuously cancels enemy invincibility (3 sec) *ATK x 4600% Area Damage  *Stuns enemies (8 sec)

abilities.name: Group: WIND BREAKER
abilities.description: WIND BREAKER Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle.  You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deploy Stun: Intelligence
abilities.description: Has a high chance of stunning all Intelligence type enemies and canceling their invincibility skill effects when Rangers deploy. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - You must wait 6 seconds before you can use an Ability again after using one with the same effect on the same type of Ranger. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
